# SheetJS

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified official SheetJS package, distributed under
Apache-2.0 (the license is included in the archive).

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
Installation guidance: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/

The official package is vendored because the npm `xlsx` package is outdated.
Keep this archive and its lockfile integrity together when updating it.
